searchText: Sigma Prime/Lighthouse are going to be moving some Prymont and Prater validators to new infrastructure over this week and next. Expect some periodic outages. I don't expect us to prevent finality, but it's possible. Weren't we going to shutdown Pyrmont? Oh, I hadn't heard about that. I'm happy with that. One less Grafana dashboard 😅 Have people started shutting down their Pyrmont nodes? I don't think anyone's actually done anything to shut it down (we haven't) but I thought we were going to test altair on it then kill it in favour of prater. We're definitely recommending people stop using it and ethstaker's bot won't make deposits for pyrmont anymore (only prater) Oh yeah cool, we have also been recommending Prater over Pyrmont. I was aware there's been a rising tide of "lets kill pyrmont" but I wasn't aware if that tide had reached a critical point. Perhaps we can discuss on this weeks eth2 call? Yeah seems like a good plan. It's possible my memory of conversations is just coloured by my desire to kill Pyrmont...
